script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
If globalRegister's 'isAppearedWedge', then
  If part 2 of executer is dead, then return game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransition.helper.bpIdx.BP3.
Let part be part 1 of executer.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of part.
Return the phase for part under the phases list with HP fraction hpRate from phase globalRegister's 'biggsBpIdx'.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let biggsBpIdx be globalRegister's 'biggsBpIdx'.
Let v be call helper with (arg).
If biggsBpIdx is not v, then
  Let v2 be list at v.
  Let part be part 1 of executer.
  Set globalRegister's 'biggsBpIdx' to v.
  Part changes to stat block the stat block of form v2's 'paramSuffixNo' on part.
  If v2's 'interruptAbilityTag', then
    Reset part.
    Part uses the move labelled v2's 'interruptAbilityTag' immediately.
  Otherwise, part cancels its cast.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let part be part 1 of executer.
If part is ready to act, then
  Let v be nothing.
  Let v2 be nothing.
  If globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToBiggs', then
    If not globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToWedge' and call helper5 with (arg), then
      Set v to the id of the move labelled "haste" on part.
      Set v2 to part 2 of executer.
    Otherwise
      Let abilityTagList be (the battle settings of executer) → get-ability-tag-list with ("biggs_without_ability_tags").
      Let ability be the id of the move labelled abilityTagList on part.
      Let v3 be the items x in ability where not call game:util.EnemyTargeting.isThereEnableAbilityTarget with (part, x, {forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
      Set v to a weighted random move of part other than v3.
  Otherwise
    Set v to the id of the move labelled "haste" on part.
    Set v2 to part.
  Part uses v with options {activeTarget: v2}.

Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let part be part 1 of executer.
part is ready to act

yes.text: not globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToWedge' and call helper5 with (arg)
Set v to the id of the move labelled "haste" on part.
Set v2 to part 2 of executer.

Let ability be the id of the move labelled abilityTagList on part.
Let v3 be the items x in ability where not call game:util.EnemyTargeting.isThereEnableAbilityTarget with (part, x, {forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
Set v to a weighted random move of part other than v3.
Set v to the id of the move labelled "haste" on part.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
If arg → get-condition-flag-in-frame with ("ability_done_for_haste"), then
  If globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToBiggs', then
    If not globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToWedge' and call helper5 with (arg), then set globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToWedge' to true.
  Otherwise, set globalRegister's 'isUsedHasteToBiggs' to true.
